_note: Necessary conditions for a website (J2_OUTPUT=website). Code checks each one on the built page after every build; the site is workable only when all are met, Audit accepts and nothing is to be confirmed. "check" names the code check (or checks) in j2.condition_met(). "plan" (optional): words a workflow in Adaptation's plan must mention, or the plan is flagged before building.

conditions.text: The page opens (it parses, tags balanced)
Every in-page link resolves; WhatsApp (wa.me) and tel: links are well formed
Every charter fact appears exactly, and nothing is "to be confirmed"
No invented content: every number, email and phone number on the page comes from the charter or the Requester's answers
Every form has a submit control and a destination (action or mailto)
A nav reaches every section, and the hero has one obvious main action
